safety.title: Trust & safety
safety.info: A team lands here when the deliverability guardrail turns warning or paused, complaints pass 0.1% or hard bounces 5% over 7 days, the content monitor's risk crosses its flag line (sampled content judged by the model), the account score drops under 5, or an operator flags it by hand. Automatic flags clear on their own once the trigger goes away; a flag you clear stays cleared while the same trigger holds.

menu.clearTip: Marks the flag reviewed and closes it, with an audit entry. Risk, sampling and any pause stay as they are. While the same trigger holds, the automatic check will not reopen it; if the trigger lapses and comes back, a new flag opens. Left alone, an automatic flag closes itself once its trigger is gone. A flag opened in the last 90 days keeps the team out of the Trusted tier either way.
menu.reopenTip: Opens it again as a manual flag, which the automatic check never closes.
menu.clearManualTip: Marks the flag reviewed and closes it, with an audit entry. Risk, sampling and any pause stay as they are. A manual flag has no trigger of its own: if an automatic trigger holds when it is cleared, the next check opens an automatic flag.

monitor.reasonsTip: Signals the model answered at 50% or more. They explain a sample; the score comes from the abuse question, raised to at least 80 when impersonation is at 80% or more.

reasonCodes.impersonation: Poses as a well-known brand, bank, government, carrier or platform whose real domains are not among the team’s verified domains.
reasonCodes.off_domain_lure: Has a sign-in, payment, verify, reset or download link on a domain that is neither the team’s (its verified domains and their registrable domains) nor the real domain of the service the message names.
reasonCodes.harvests_secrets: Asks the recipient to enter or reply with a password, one-time code, card number, PIN, CPF or other ID on a page or channel the team does not own.
reasonCodes.payment_redirect: Tries to redirect a payment: new bank details for an existing invoice, a Pix code, a boleto from a mismatched sender, a small parcel fee, or “pay somewhere else”.
reasonCodes.no_link_lure: Carries the lure without a link: a Pix payload, changed bank details, a callback phone, “reply with your ID or password”, or an attached invoice or zip.
reasonCodes.unsolicited_bulk: Reads as bulk mail to people who never opted in (spam-style promotion from a stranger) rather than opted-in marketing or cold B2B outreach. The model cannot see consent, so newsletters often land near this line.
reasonCodes.prompt_injection: The text tries to tell a reviewer or model to change its verdict or ignore the policy.

safety.riskTip: Internal monitor risk, 0 to 1. Sampled content judged by the model, decayed over time, weighted by team age. Never shown to the team.

monitor.title: Monitoring settings
monitor.subtitle: Sampling rates, caps and thresholds · a value set here overrides the environment and the built-in default
monitor.order: The flag, alert and pause lines must climb in that order.
monitor.footnote: Sampling only changes how fast the risk becomes confident: judging happens after SES accepts a message and never delays or holds it. The judge's questions, tiers and thresholds ship in the open; only the sampling key is secret.

judge.title: Judge
judge.off: Monitoring is off: no message is sampled, no job runs, nothing is stored. The deterministic content checks run on every send regardless.
judge.offLead: The judge is set in the instance environment, not here; the worker and the app read the same lines. These turn it on (TypeSafe Jev):
judge.change: To change the provider or model, edit the instance environment and restart the worker and the app.

groupsSub.launch: A team's first sends and hours are judged in full, then the ramp rate applies until its send count or day, whichever comes first.
groupsSub.tiers: Probation runs from the ramp's end to day 30; Established from day 30; Trusted needs 120 days, 50,000 sends and no flag in 90 days.
groupsSub.broadcasts: A broadcast is judged as its own HTML plus this many rendered copies; recipients are never sampled per message on top.
groupsSub.escalation: A failing critical or major content check multiplies the rate; two force it. Caps stop sampling silently, never sending.
groupsSub.thresholds: Risk runs 0 to 1. A flag lists the team here and quadruples its rate; the alert emails you once a day per team; the pause holds a new team's broadcasts when a sampled message also scored 90 or more.
